segments: Morning, both. Quick ops sync today, I've got a hard stop at the half hour.
Sure. Onboarding queue first. We have nine new accounts waiting for setup, up from six last week.
Mostly the job import. Customers send us spreadsheets in every format you can imagine.
I'd like to publish one import template and reject anything that doesn't match it.
Rejecting feels harsh. Can we publish the template and offer help with anything that doesn't fit?
That works. I'll have the template on the help center by Thursday.
Second thing, our own field crew. Two of the four test vans are due for a service this month.
Can we stagger them, so the crew always has three vans on the road?
Yes. One goes in on the twelfth and the other on the nineteenth.
Good. Last item is holiday cover for the onboarding calls.
I'll cover the week of the twenty-third of November, and Imke takes the week after.
Fine by me. I'll put both weeks in the team calendar today.

enhanced.markdown: **Onboarding:** 9 new accounts are waiting for setup, up from 6 last week, mostly held up by job imports. Imke publishes one import template on the help center by Thursday; files that don't fit get help instead of being rejected.
